'''Iainoa''', officially the '''Republic of Iainoa''', is a country in [[South New Ayre]]. It is bordered to the north and west by [[Andsaudare]], to the east by [[Umarcia]] and the [[Dursio Sea]], and to the south by the [[Southern Eanif Ocean]]. Iainoa has a population of over [[List of countries and dependencies by population|15 million]], and its capital and largest city is [[Evue]]. At {{convert|326,950|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}}, Iainoa is the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|91st largest country in the world]], and the [[List of New Ayre countries by area|ninth largest in New Ayre]].

[[Pre-Alqiran Iainoa|Iainoan territory]] was home to [[Fedaea civilizations|several cultures]] during the ancient and medieval periods, and has one of the longest histories of civilization of any country, tracing its heritage back to the 10th millennium BFA [[Syalo civilization]], the earliest civilization in New Ayre and considered one of the [[Cradle of civilization|cradles of civilization]]. Notable succeeding cultures and civilisations include the [[Rilosu culture]], the [[Msu culture|Msu]], [[Isu Empire|Isu]] and [[Seecain Empire|Seecain]] empires, the [[Iainoan  Empire]], the largest known state in the [[Pre-Alqiran era|pre-Alqiran]] New Ayre. The [[Tavalan Empire]] conquered the region in the early 14th century and established a colony with the official name of the [[Real Kocis Delaosa]] that encompassed most of its Southern New Ayren territories, with its capital in [[Evue]].<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Loriarer|first1=Ilmael|title=Aenastirgue ill ae sti faila Iainoa|journal=[[University of Tyeusurnu]]|date=1764|url=https://dspaace.unitru.edu.iai/server/api/core/bitstreams/b4664398-8f69-4d88-b426-c04edaa8cc8d/content}}</ref> Higher education started in New Ayre with the official establishment of the [[National University of Tyeusurnu]] in [[Evue]] in 1349.

Iainoa formally proclaimed independence from Taval in 1585, and following the military campaigns of [[Inarin E’Idue]], as well as the decisive [[battle of hirvani]], it [[Iainoan War of Independence|completed its independence in 1585]]. In the ensuing years, the country first suffered from political instability until a period of relative [[Guano Era|economic and political stability]] began due to the exploitation of [[Wikipedia:guano|guano]] that ended with the [[First Andsaudaran-Iainoan War|first]] and [[Second Andsaudaran-Iainoan War]]. Throughout the 16th century, Iainoa grappled with political and social instability, including the [[Internal conflict in Iainoa|internal conflict]] between the state and guerrilla groups, interspersed with periods of economic growth.

Iainoa shifted towards a sort of [[Wikipedia:neoliberal economics|neoliberal economics]] under the authoritarian rule of [[Phyally Mori]] in the 1720s, with the former's political ideology of [[Morism]] leaving a lasting imprint on the country's governance that continues to the present day. The later half of the 18th century marked economic expansion and poverty reduction, but the subsequent decade revealed long-existing sociopolitical vulnerabilities, exacerbated by a [[Iainoan political crisis (1752–present)|political crisis]].

The [[Wikipedia:sovereign state|sovereign state]] of Iainoa is a [[Wikipedia:Parliamentary republic|Federal parliamentary republic]] divided into [[Administrative divisions of Iainoa|11 regions]]. Its main economic activities include [[Wikipedia:mining|mining]], [[Wikipedia:manufacturing|manufacturing]], agriculture and fishing, along with other growing sectors such as [[Wikipedia:telecommunications|telecommunications]] and [[Wikipedia:|biotechnology]]. Iainoa ranks high in [[Wikipedia:social freedom|social freedom]]; it is an active member of  the [[New Ayren Alliance]], the [[Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Ayren Partnership]] and the [[Global Trade Union]]; and is considered as a [[middle power]].

Iainoa's population includes [[Sili|Silis]], [[Indigenous peoples of Iainoa|Viadaillon]], [[Ayuman’s in Iainoa|Ayuman’s]], [[Massiran’s in Iainoa|Massiran’s]], and [[Mahean’s in Iainoa|Mahean’s]]. The main spoken language is [[Iainoan]], although a significant number of Iainoan’s speak [[Alqiran language|Alqiran]], or a variety [[Languages of Iainoa|Indigenous languages]]. This mixture of cultural traditions has resulted in a wide diversity of expressions in fields such as [[Iainoan art|art]], [[Iainoan cuisine|cuisine]], [[Iainoan literature|literature]], and [[Music of Iainoa|music]]. Iainoa has recently gained international recognition for its vibrant gastronomy, blending Indigenous, [[Alqiran]], [[Massir|Massiran]], and [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] influences. [[Evue]] is now considered a global culinary capital, home to award-winning restaurants like [[Eural Yari Aralrial]] and Eural Airith.
